base_manifest.kind: synthetic-only experimental bases for grouped holdout; not new laboratory references
base_manifest.usage: Use only the file whose excluded_sample matches the real test sample. Do not merge folds and then score the same four real samples; that would leak their source spectra and labels.

results.json.protocol: Only synthetic rows in estimator; outer real physical sample excluded from generation (spectra and Kappa). All repeated readings grouped. Four real laboratory references scored; Celulose Branqueada assumed excluded.
results.json.assumption: Observed white-scan covariance divided by 10 models uncertainty of mean reference, assuming exchangeable scans. Stress multipliers 3 and 10 are scenarios, not measured guarantees. Sample scatter/noise/offset and mixup relation are hypotheses. Calibration characterization is shared; individual heldout sample spectra and labels are not used in synthetic generation.

sobol_results.json.protocol: Only synthetic estimator inputs; heldout physical sample excluded from all generator parents and labels. Four real groups only. Sobol dimension 15 covers declared bounded/gaussian nuisance envelopes, not all possible spectra or new chemical reference information.

components_results.json.protocol: Exploratory screening, then fixed-seed confirmation. Real heldout physical sample excluded from generator parents and labels. Only synthetic points in estimator. Selection uses the same four reference outcomes and is not independent validation.
